explanation.description: One or two sentences saying in words what the equation means.
explanation.title: Explanation

id.description: 1-based slide number, unique within the deck.
id.title: Id

bullets.description: Short bullet points shown on the slide.
bullets.title: Bullets

talking_points.description: What the lecturer explains while the slide is shown and that is NOT written on it: intuition, why it matters, a worked example with its numbers, a common mistake. Taken from the source documents; reviewed with the slide.
talking_points.title: Talking Points

notes.description: Optional lecturer notes; not shown on the slide.
notes.title: Notes

source_section.description: Heading of the source section this slide was derived from.
source_section.title: Source Section

kind.description: theory: from lecture notes; exercise: a problem statement; solution: steps of the official solution.
kind.title: Kind

source_doc.description: Source document (and problem), e.g. 'Problem Set 2, Problem 2'. Set by the pipeline from the course index, not by the LLM.
source_doc.title: Source Doc

language.description: BCP-47 language code of the slide text.
language.title: Language

approved.description: Set to true by the lecturer review step, never by the LLM.
approved.title: Approved
